summary: Blake (climbing with Chase Smith) dislodged a large block while leading Beside the Pillar (5.10c) on Zappa Wall; a microwave-sized rock struck his face causing a major laceration requiring surgery; conscious and able to hike, the pair self-evacuated.
location: Beside the Pillar, Zappa Wall, Escalante Canyon, Grand Junction area
notes: ANAC 2025 edition (Pub 2025); incident date Dec 23 per article; self-evacuated, no SAR.
